name: screenshot
description:
Captura visual no intrusiva de pantalla, aplicaciones y ventanas en tiempo real mediante WGC, GDI BitBlt y PrintWindow.
Acciones y argumentos (usar en args): app { process_name, app_name, title, format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | capture_app { process_name, app_name, title, format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | capture_screen { format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | capture_window { hwnd, handle, title, format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | desktop { format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | inspect { path, file, filePath } | region { format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | screen { format, revealPath, allow_user_path } | window { hwnd, handle, title, format, revealPath, allow_user_path }

action.description: Acción a ejecutar en el dominio screenshot
